Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling southbound on a two-lane road in Katy, Texas, and began a left turn across the northbound
lane when the front of the vehicle struck the side of a northbound sedan driven by Dirver 2. The impact occurred in
the intersection during daylight, and the road surface was dry. Driver 1 remained belted in the driver's seat and
reported pain in the left wrist after the collision. The Passenger, seated in the front right seat, was identified at the
scene and confirmed to be riding in the vehicle at the time of the crash.
Driver 2 stated that the turning vehilce entered the lane directly ahead and that the collision could not be avoided.
Two independent witnesses gave statements consistent with that account, and photographs taken at the scene show
damage to both vehicles that matches the described sequence. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle has been
reported to this department. Some of the damage visible on the vehicle's rear quarter panel may not have resulted
from this impact, and that question has been referred for further review. Driver 1 is listed as a member of the
policyholder's household and was operating the vehicle with the policyholder's knowledge.
